name: headcountlabs-public-services
description: Find where to get public services in the U.S.: food pantries, SNAP and WIC sites, community health centers, Head Start, HUD housing counselors, senior and city service centers near a point, with address, phone, hours, requirements and languages where known. Also look up government programs by name or assistance listing number (10.551 is SNAP) and the agencies that run them. Directory facts only; it never decides eligibility. Read-only, no account or API key. Preview data with sources on every record.
